method.tool: Vercel MCP deploy_to_vercel (target=production, name=proklinator-static, teamId omitted)
method.description: build.mjs fetches the 73 site files (2860858 B) from raw.githubusercontent.com (fallback: cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh, 3 attempts per source on network errors / non-2xx / 30 s timeouts, 8 in flight; a hash or length mismatch is never retried on the same source and moves straight to the next one) at the pinned commit 5a5ecd3 and aborts with exit 1 unless each file's byte length and SHA-256 match the values in `files` above, then writes them to ./public and re-reads the output tree to prove it holds exactly the manifest (nothing missing, nothing extra, sizes and hashes exact, total exact). The deployment therefore contains exactly the repo bytes of the pinned commit; this is the same pattern as the v20 … v20.6 deploys. The manifest was generated from the pinned commit's git blobs (git ls-tree -r -l + git cat-file blob; HEAD == origin/main == 5a5ecd3 after a fresh fetch and fast-forward from 44719fc, clean tree, every blob cross-checked against the working tree, 0 mismatches) and the script was dry-run locally before deploying with Node 22.14 (73/73 files fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com in 2.9 s and byte-identical to the checkout, output tree == manifest, no README / DEPLOY_RESULT / docs / tools / .gitignore / build.mjs / package.json in the output), together with a negative test (one tampered hash for app.js -> both sources rejected, public/app.js never written, the build aborts with exit 1 after 72/73) and a fallback test (raw host replaced by an unreachable name -> all 73 files come from cdn.jsdelivr.net in 23.8 s, still byte-identical). The Vercel build finished in under 2.5 minutes: the raw deployment URL served the verified v20.7 index at the first poll (19:09:39Z) and the public alias was already on v20.7 at 19:09:50Z.

notes: The task described the repository as private; gh reports visibility PUBLIC (isPrivate false), which is what makes the unauthenticated pinned-commit fetch in build.mjs possible. If the repo is ever made private, this deploy method needs a token or an inline file tree.

The local checkout booted at 44719fc (merge of PR #17, v20.6 record); origin/main was fetched first and fast-forwarded to 5a5ecd3 (merge of PR #18) before the manifest was generated, so the pinned SHA is the one named in the task.
Git-linked auto-deploy was not used, for the same reasons as before: create_git_project requires teamId (the 403 trigger) and cannot re-link the existing unlinked project proklinator-static.

teamId was omitted from deploy_to_vercel, as in the prior successful deploys; no 403 occurred. Team-scoped read endpoints were not usable for this token (get_deployment with the known team id or slug -> 404 'Deployment not found', list_deployments -> 403 forbidden), so the build was followed and verified over HTTP against the raw deployment URL and the public alias.

The existing project proklinator-static was reused (protection already off); no new project was created and no auth/SSO/protection settings were touched. Registration and payments were not opened. Auth stays NO-GO.

README.md, DEPLOY_RESULT.json, docs/ (including docs/content), .gitignore and tools/build_assets.py stay out of the deployment; ATTRIBUTIONS.md and assets/fx/LICENSE-kenney.txt stay in so the CC0 / ISC / OFL attributions travel with the served files.

The headless smoke wrote only to the headless browser's own throwaway profiles (pk_intro_v20 gate record, one history entry, one pk_game record per run); the site has no backend and nothing was sent anywhere.

The game layer is local-only by design: pk_game never leaves localStorage, the karma table stays a parody («Пародия. Сети нет.»), and the daily case is derived from the local date — no new network requests appeared in either headless run beyond the v20.6 set plus the lazily loaded FX sprites.
No app code was changed for this deploy; this commit updates DEPLOY_RESULT.json only.
